claims: Team USA defeated the Dominican Republic 2-1 on March 15, 2026, in the 2026 World Baseball Classic semifinal.
Team USA advanced to their third consecutive WBC final.
Paul Skenes and USA relief pitching held the Dominican Republic's offense to one run.
Gunnar Henderson hit a home run for Team USA.
Roman Anthony hit a home run for Team USA.
USA bullpen, including Mason Miller, secured the win.
Junior Caminero scored the only run for the Dominican Republic.
The game ended on a called strike three by Mason Miller against Geraldo Perdomo in the 9th inning.
Broadcasters noted the called strike three was not in the strike zone.
The game was played at LoanDepot Park in Miami.
The game was played before a sellout crowd
